name: duckweed
title: Duckweed Fronds
subtitle: Frond count and area for floating aquatic plants
description: Counts individual fronds and measures total and mean frond area for duckweed on a water surface. One summary row per image.
method: HSB conversion; fronds = hue 45-115 AND saturation >= 50, which rejects grey specular reflection off the water. Despeckle, morphological closing, fill holes, then watershed so touching colonies still resolve as separate fronds.
dataType: overhead images of Lemna, Landoltia or Wolffia on still water
notes: Relative growth rate needs two time points and is deliberately not emitted from a single image.

commonColumns.Label: Source image title
commonColumns.Unit: Spatial unit of every length/area column
commonColumns.Calibrated: 1 if a scale was applied; 0 means all values are in pixels
